تقهقرت (form IIq)
# تَقَهْقَرْتُ (taqahqartu) /ta.qah.qar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# تَقَهْقَرْتَ (taqahqarta) /ta.qah.qar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# تَقَهْقَرْتِ (taqahqarti) /ta.qah.qar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# تَقَهْقَرَتْ (taqahqarat) /ta.qah.qa.rat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
